newsitem.title: USA: Reeve gets star on Hollywood Walk of Fame.
newsitem.headline: Reeve gets star on Hollywood Walk of Fame.

text.p: Actor Christopher Reeve, paralysed two years ago in a horseriding accident, received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on Tuesday and told fans he hoped some day to walk again.
Reeve said that "... if we keep giving our scientists the funding they need for research, soon I will take my family by the hand and will stand here in front of the star."

The "Superman" star, accompanied by his wife, Dana, and son, Will, was nursing a broken arm, the result of being dropped last week by two helpers who were moving him on to a chair in an accident he called, "just bad luck."
In addition to about 500 fans, the ceremony was witnessed by actresses Glenn Close and Jane Seymour, who star in Reeve's upcoming directorial debut, "In the Gloaming."
Close described Reeve as, "The most human of humans, a man with great beauty ... and a man who refuses to let go of his dreams."
